name: IBM uRaman-Dataset: peak-normalized stitched Raman spectra of five MOF-74 metal-series samples in the nominal 70-3,000 cm^-1 window
description: Peak-normalized stitched Raman spectra of the five MOF-74 metal-series samples available in the deposit's 70-3,000 cm^-1 window (nominal; the native axis is 0-2,999.35 cm^-1, 5,266 points), measured with a WITec Alpha 300 RAS micro-Raman system (532 nm at 1 mW, 1800 g/mm grating, 100 accumulations x 0.5 s; the samples were provided by Prof. Carlos Basilio Pinheiro's group, per the deposit's About.md). Au@Mg-MOF74 has no stitched spectrum - the deposit's About.md states 'No spectral stitching is available for Au@Mg-MOF74 due to a high luminescence background'. The native grids are resampled with linear interpolation onto the common 0-2,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,000 points). All five spectra are peak-normalized (max = 1.0) as deposited, with no negative points in this window. One spectrum per class (5 classes): a reference set, not CV-learnable. is_grouped=False. Served from the same commit-pinned codeload archive as uraman_mofs (commit 47e712d326fb0458ee8218ab73a2cfc269dcdfab, 819,336 bytes, size + sha256 pinned).

rai:dataCollection: Stitched Raman measurements of five MOF-74 metal-series samples in the nominal 70-3,000 cm^-1 window; WITec Alpha 300 RAS, 532 nm at 1 mW, 1800 g/mm grating, 100 accumulations x 0.5 s; samples provided by Prof. Carlos Basilio Pinheiro's group.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Peak normalization to max = 1.0 as deposited; the WITec exports of this window carry no background subtraction (all intensities >= 0). The loader linearly interpolates the native 5,266-point 0-2,999.35 cm^-1 grids onto the common 0-2,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,000 points); no baseline correction, smoothing or other preprocessing is applied.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Sample identities are given by the deposit's file and folder names (MOF-74 metal-series composition: Me = Mg, Zn, Zn75Mg25; Au@ = gold-coated variant); the labels are derived from the deposit's filenames, not re-curated for this benchmark. Au@Mg-MOF74 is absent from this window because no stitched spectrum was recorded for it.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal or sensitive information is included. All samples are inorganic MOF-74 metal-series materials.
rai:dataBiases: Single facility (IBM) and single instrument (WITec Alpha 300 RAS, 532 nm, 1 mW). One stitched spectrum per sample, so there is no replicate structure and no within-class variance. The sample set differs from the 1,000-2,000 cm^-1 window (no Au@Mg-MOF74), so the two keys cannot be joined into a single per-material comparison; spectra are not comparable to the top-level compounds measured at 532/633 nm (see uraman_mofs).
rai:dataLimitations: One stitched spectrum per sample (5 samples) - a reference set, not a CV-learnable classification; single instrument/facility; Au@Mg-MOF74 is missing (high luminescence background prevented stitching); peak normalization to 1.0 removes absolute intensity information; the CDLA-Sharing-1.0 license is share-alike (commercial use allowed, derivative works must carry the same license).
rai:dataSocialImpact: Materials-science reference data for the MOF-74 metal series (candidate gas-sensing and CO2-capture materials); no human or medical use.
rai:dataUseCases: Reference spectra for spectral matching and few-shot / augmentation use; full-window (0-3,000 cm^-1) metal-series comparison for the five available samples; not suitable for CV-based classification (one spectrum per class).
prov:wasGeneratedBy: Data collection: stitched Raman spectra of five MOF-74 metal-series samples (Mg-MOF74, Zn-MOF74, Zn75Mg25-MOF74, Au@Zn-MOF74, Au@Zn75Mg25-MOF74) measured in the nominal 70-3,000 cm^-1 window (native axis 0-2,999.35 cm^-1, 5,266 points) with a WITec Alpha 300 RAS micro-Raman system (532 nm excitation, 1 mW, 1800 g/mm grating, 100 accumulations x 0.5 s); the samples were provided by Prof. Carlos Basilio Pinheiro's group (per the deposit's About.md). Au@Mg-MOF74 has no stitched spectrum ('No spectral stitching is available for Au@Mg-MOF74 due to a high luminescence background', per the deposit). Part of IBM's uRaman-Dataset (commit 47e712d326fb0458ee8218ab73a2cfc269dcdfab, 2023-06-19, CDLA-Sharing-1.0, maintainer Matheus Esteves Ferreira); no indexed parent paper exists, so the repository is the citation. All spectra are peak-normalized (max = 1.0) as deposited. This raman_data key resamples the native grids onto the common 0-2,999 cm^-1 @1 cm^-1 grid (3,000 points).
